about_the_game:
"Farming Pets" is a cute pixel-style idle treasure-hunting desktop pet game that perfectly blends idle gameplay, character progression, and interactive desktop companionship. In the game, your lumberjack pet will continuously chop wood through typing interactions or background idling, gather abundant resources, build unique combat builds, and challenge progressively powerful bosses.

Core Gameplay Features

🪓 Diverse Progression System

  • Free Attribute Allocation: Freely distribute stats like Strength, Agility, and Intelligence to shape your exclusive combat style.

  • In-depth Equipment Customization:

    • Purchase basic equipment from the shop.

    • Affix Reforging & Rerolling: Continuously optimize equipment attributes.

    • Gem Socketing System: Attach special effects to equipment.

  • Skill Advancement System:

    • Skill Tier-Up: Quickly exchange for higher-tier skills.

    • Skill Devouring: Strengthen skills by consuming duplicates.

🌲 Dual Resource Acquisition Modes

  • Active Interaction Mode: Typing inputs accelerate your pet's woodchopping, granting extra rewards.

  • Idle AFK Mode: Your pet continues to work and accumulate resources even when you're away from the game.

  • Dynamic Resource Balance: Intelligently adjusts gains based on your play habits.

🏆 Two Core Game Modes

1. Main Mode: Endless Progression Challenge

  • Collect equipment, skills, and experience through continuous woodchopping.

  • Unlock and challenge a series of unique bosses, each with distinct mechanics.

  • Unlimited growth potential with countless combinations of equipment and skills.

2. Roguelike Mode: Strategic Limit Challenge

  • Limited Woodchopping Attempts: Each run grants only a fixed number of woodchopping chances.

  • Event Choice System: Random buffs, debuffs, or special events appear after each woodchopping session.

  • Progressive Difficulty: Unlock the next difficulty tier automatically after defeating a boss.

  • Leaderboards: Show off your pet's progression layer on the global rankings!

"Farming Pets" is more than just a game—it's an intelligent companion for your work and study. Every keystroke fuels your progress, and every idle moment brings unexpected rewards. Transform your desktop time into an experience that's both productive and fun!

  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or later) or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Metal compatible)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
